title: Saving no longer loses pads
thisBuild: A mess with sounds this phone does not have (from the site, a pack you have not got, or later the iPhone) keeps those pads. They read MISSING and stay quiet, and saving keeps them, their steps and their settings.
Anything the site or the iPhone app adds to a mess file now survives a save here.
Nothing else changed: same keys, sounds and layout as the last build.
watch: Open a mess from the site that uses one of your uploaded sounds: does its pad say MISSING instead of going empty?
Save it, reopen it: is the pad still there?
limits: A MISSING pad stays quiet until its sound is on this phone. To use a different sound there, put one on it from the Sounds tab as usual.
